description.en: CSVFidelity-Bench evaluates knowledge graph construction from statistical tables, focusing on the effect of extraction schema and format coupling on fidelity. It includes 15 datasets, 11 Type-II and 4 Type-III tables, with 1,892 gold standard facts across 6 domains.
